title: How to use ChatGPT to negotiate your salary

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know ChatGPT can help you negotiate a better salary?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: With AI-powered tools, you can now level the playing field in job offers.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: ChatGPT can generate strong, data-backed salary negotiation letters in seconds.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses real-world salary data from 2024 to suggest realistic figures.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects everyone looking for a raise or a new job right now.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Remember: leverage AI to speak the language of employers.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to see how? Hit follow and I’ll show you my top prompts.
